experience.title: Experience
experience.lead: I started in support, moved through functional analysis, and today I build and run systems in production.

bullets: I build software solutions for ABN, a digital marketing company, focused on automating and simplifying the Digital Media team's daily work.
I manage the infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), handling deployments, server maintenance and the operation of applications in production.
I manage permissions and access for users and cloud services, ensuring a secure privilege setup for each role.
I define infrastructure as code (IaC), ensuring reproducible, versioned and consistent environments.
I implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate application integration and deployment, reducing manual errors and delivery times.
I co-founded a studio building custom web and mobile apps; together with the team I lead the functional analysis, design, development, deployment and infrastructure of every solution.
ERPs, admin platforms and mobile apps with payment gateways, subscriptions, real-time notifications and admin dashboards.
I automate deployments with Docker, GitHub Actions, Linux servers and reverse proxies, and manage the development and production environments.
I support clients through requirements gathering, technical definition and project planning.

utn.description: Three roles, from support to development

developer.title: Software Developer
bullets: Web apps, mobile apps and microservices for the university, across their whole lifecycle.
Centralized authentication with Keycloak for users, microservices and APIs: SSO, OAuth2 / OpenID Connect, JWT, Client Credentials, roles and permissions.
Generative AI with RAG, semantic search over vector databases and tool calling to query institutional data in real time.
Asynchronous queues with BullMQ and Redis for emails and notifications, plus integrations with LDAP, SIU Guaraní and REST APIs.

analyst.title: Functional Analyst
bullets: Requirements gathering with clients and users, turned into user stories, use cases and UML diagrams.
Functional validation with the development team and QA testing before every release.

support.title: Application Support
bullets: Incident diagnosis through admin interfaces, logs and database queries.
Role, permission and access management, following every case through to resolution.

projects.title: Projects
projects.lead: Management systems, mobile apps, microservices and applied AI. Pick one to see the problem it solved and how I built it.

moviltrack.title: Moviltrack
moviltrack.description: Enterprise management system: projects, clients, suppliers, quotes, purchase orders, expenses and recurring billing in one place.
challenges: Dual currency (MXN / USD) with different exchange rates across the whole system
Real-time PDF generation for every document type
Automatic recurring charges and a drag & drop quote builder

ripalive.title: RIP Alive
ripalive.description: Personal legacy app to keep your important information organized for your family, with subscriptions and a store. Includes an admin panel and a web portal for beneficiaries.
challenges: Google Play and App Store subscriptions with RevenueCat, and payments with Stripe
Beneficiary access that unlocks only if the account holder doesn't respond within the period they set
Real-time notifications and referrals with cashback

credential.title: Credencial UTN + AI
credential.description: Digital ID for UTN students: QR validation, real-time academic information and an assistant that answers questions.
challenges: RAG chat: semantic search over a vector database + tool calling to the university database
Student validation with a temporary, encrypted QR code
Keycloak login and SIU-Guaraní integration

sicyt.title: SICYT
sicyt.description: Projects and researchers system for UTN FRBA: research projects, teams, documents and researcher categorization in a single platform, with the regulations validated automatically.
challenges: Rules engine versioned by year: each project is validated against the regulations of its start year, and every change is audited
Staged, batch-based recategorization process, from the Board of Directors to the Rector's Office, with the history of every step
Emails and notifications queued with BullMQ and dedicated workers, respecting each user's preferences

difusiones.title: Diffusions
difusiones.description: Bulk email service for a university portal: recipient lists, rich text editor, attachments, scheduled sends and tracking for every campaign.
challenges: Semaphores for bulk sending without getting blocked by the email provider
Tracking who opened each campaign
Keycloak authentication through the API Gateway

traducciones.title: Translations
traducciones.description: File translation and proofreading for a university portal: document upload and download, roles for each type of user and email alerts.
challenges: Microservice architecture with Keycloak authentication through the API Gateway
File management for the documents of each request
Users and roles managed in Keycloak

toon.title: Toon Guesser
toon.description: A game for guessing cartoon characters: every day there's a new one that starts pixelated in black and white and gains color and detail with each guess.
challenges: Canvas-based image with different levels of pixelation and color depending on the guesses
Game state saved with no database or authentication
Cron job that picks the character of the day without repeating previous ones

pap.title: Paso a Paso
pap.description: Website for a wholesale company: a product catalog with an inquiry cart and a panel to manage products and the site's general settings.
challenges: Catalogs, categories and products customizable from the admin panel
File management for product images

planner.title: Organizer
planner.description: Organizer for actionable, on-hold, recurring or scheduled notes and tasks, with a Markdown editor and reminders of what's due today.
challenges: Text editor with Markdown support
Shared table structure, with specific features for each type of note or task
